name: Commerce Minimum Order
description: Enforces a per-store minimum order amount on the Commerce cart: shows a progress meter and blocks checkout until the total is reached.
project_description:
This module prevents checkout until the minimum order amount is met. It is possible to optionally define a minimum order amount for the store(s) on the site. A progress bar indicator can be added to display the order status.

 

 Installation 
 
 Create a field with "field_store_min_order" machine name for the store entity type (field type: Number). 
 Add a value to this field for each store as required. 
 
 This module does not provide styling for the progress bar but is compatible with Bootstrap. To customize the appearance, create a Twig template in your custom theme.
